examples.pie: h₁yód nébʰos kl̥Héni sédyeti h₂wérst. h₁yód h₃mígʰleh₂ liméni ḱéyor ne h₂wérst. n̥bʰrós péruns gʷm̥sḱéti h₂erh₃wóm-kʷe ḱéleti. h₂énh₁mos nébʰos wédʰeti.

examples.pie: h₁regʷesyéti kʷséps gʷm̥yéti. nu sóh₂wl̥ wódr̥ Hn̥dʰí séngʷs. ph₂ter n̥smé nékʷti h₂lékse. l̥gʰih₁mé swépnos n̥smé h₁pyéh₁t. ḱwṓ nos ḱléytreh₂m h₂léksoyh₁t pérkʷus n̥smé ḱéloyh₁t. bʰudʰih₁mé léwkm̥-kʷe h₂ew dedr̥ḱih₁mé.

examples.pie: ǵĺ̥h₂ow toy nos kápros ǵr̥h₂nóm h₂éḱh₃t. bʰréh₂tēr toy tóm káprom stérgeti ne me ḱlowséyeti. nu moy bʰréh₂trey mléwHoh₂. h₁ésmey mluHdʰí. káprom Hwérowos. h₁ím Hwérowos mē-kʷe wikṓwos. kápros h₂egʰós wé swésorh₁e.

examples.en: Man, you took the larger share! I was first, and they wounded me. They wounded me too. Look at my leg! Then let us divide the plunder in two. Who will divide it? Let the wise old man divide it. I will heed him. And let us two not fight.

examples.pie: kúdʰe toy h₂éwh₂e stégos h₁ésti? dṓm moy méǵh₂i déh₂newi stestóh₂e. h₁éḱwons h₂eh₂óyḱth₂e? kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons kʷékʷlom-kʷe h₂eh₂óyḱh₂e. sémeh₂i méǵʰye ḱóm gʷm̥dʰí h₁íns-kʷe kʷéḱesi.
examples.en: Uncle, where is your house? My house stands by a great river. Do you own horses? I own four horses and a wagon. Come with me in the summer, and you will see them.

examples.pie: kʷíd ǵń̥h₃ra gʷḗn mḗh₁n̥s? mḗh₁n̥s lówksneh₂s stóygʰos. lówksneh₂ ǵeǵónh₁e h₂wékst néḱt-kʷe. kʷíd yóh₁r̥? yóh₁r̥ ǵʰéyōm sémeh₂-kʷe. kʷíd prḗḱs? ǵn̥h₃rós bʰuHyéh₁m̥. ǵn̥h₃rós bʰúHesi h₁yód ḱléwsēsi.
examples.en: Wise woman, what is a month? A month is the path of the moon. The moon is born, it grows, and it vanishes. And what is a year? A year is a winter and a summer. Why did you ask? May I become wise! You will become wise, if you listen.

examples.pie: kʷíd ḱwṓ dʰwóri légʰeti? wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím skélesi dénḱt. gʷíh₃wēti? gʷíh₃wēti méh₂tēr moy h₁ím mḗdeti. h₁éy dʰr̥sús.
examples.en: Why is the dog lying at the door? A wolf bit him in the leg. Will he live? He will live; my mother is healing him. He is brave.

examples.pie: dinóy nékʷti-kʷe tékʷeti ne-kʷe ḱémh₂t. skélesh₂ h₁ésmey ne h₁ésti móri-kʷe éti h₁éyti. dʰǵʰúHes h₁ésmi gʷíh₃wonti gʷówes-kʷe h₁ésmōd ph₃ént. kʷíd h₁íd? h₁íd déh₂nu.
examples.en: It runs by day and by night, and it does not become tired. It has no legs, and yet it goes to the sea. Fish live in it, and cattle drink from it. What is it? It is the river.

examples.pie: kúdʰe te ǵʰoysós térh₃t? skélesi me térh₃t. gʷḗn h₁íd mḗdēsi? h₁íd mḗdōh₂. l̥gʰdʰí th₂kéh₁ye-kʷe. h₂ew stéygʰōh₂? méh₁nsi stéygʰēsi. wiḱpótim ḱósyeh₂i sémeh₂i ne sékʷesi. nu moy bʰréh₂tēr gʷéru bʰérēti.
examples.en: Where did the spear wound you? It wounded me in the leg. Will you heal it, woman? I will heal it. Lie down and keep silent. Will I walk again? You will walk within a month. But you will not follow the lord this summer. Then my brother will carry the spear.
